description: Variation of Condition 2 (approved drawings) of planning permission reference 73243/APP/2025/1523, dated18-11-25 (Variation of Condition 2 (approved drawings) of planning permission reference 73243/APP/2022/2535, dated 20-11-2024, for the 'Erection of 6 dwellings with new access to Foxdell and erection of 3 dwellings with new access to Dene Road with associated landscaping and parking'. Amendment seeks to vary the design of Plots 3-6, including repositioning of the building southwards, reduction in depth, increase in width, lowering the finished slab level by 700mm, addition of habitable attic accommodation with front-facing dormers and sky lights and increase in height, changes to fenestration and position of chimney stack and addition of solar panels to flat roof area.) to install of PV panels on the roofs of the plots 1-2 and the flats Plots 3-6. Installation of a sedum roofed carport, enhancing biodiversity of the site Plots 8-9. To amend the position of the approved location of plots 7-9.
